svg.title: 6G DRL/KDDL system architecture
svg.desc: Top-down architecture: simulated environments feed an offline pretraining stage, which warm-starts three agent paradigms (single-agent baseline, GAT-CRL cooperative MARL, KDDL modules), which pass through a Lagrangian safety layer before deployment, with a digital twin recalibrating the environment in a feedback loop.

g.text: RRM · UAV · RIS envs + graph topology
SLA sweep → expert policy DB → selector
Sent to simulated RAN / next episode
